sourceDecision: Retain production. Row is declared Record<string, string | number> & { id: string }. Each ordered column produces a td keyed by the original item.key and its child is directly row[item.key]. This expression uses the exact column key and declares no dotted-path parsing, nullish fallback, String/toString conversion, formatting or row/object mutation. The static type is not runtime validation and does not establish behavior for absent/invalid runtime values. Contrary to the incoming premise, nullish fallback and scalar-to-text conversion are not present in this cell declaration. The saved metadata tests replace the real table and do not qualify rendered cells or conversions. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
